title: Dodrio's Third Head Wasn't Added
premise: Dodrio evolves from Doduo when one of Doduo's two heads splits into two.
audiencePromise: Watch one head split into two, then see why Dodrio's three brains are useful and risky.
openLoop: Can two heads become three without adding a new one?
payoff: After the split, Dodrio uses three brains for complex plans, but may think too much and become immobilized.
engagementQuestion: Are three brains an advantage, or too much thinking?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a strange discovery. Keep the pace quick, warm, and clear. Punch the words split, three brains, and immobilized. Pause briefly before the reveal.

scenes.headline: A HEAD SPLITS IN TWO
scenes.narration: Dodrio's third head begins as part of another head.
scenes.caption: THE THIRD HEAD WASN'T ADDED

scenes.headline: THE TWO-HEAD START
scenes.narration: Doduo starts with two heads and evolves at level thirty-one.
scenes.caption: DODUO • TWO HEADS

scenes.headline: ONE BECOMES TWO
scenes.narration: One head splits in two, turning Doduo's two heads into three.
scenes.caption: ONE HEAD → TWO

scenes.headline: A UNIQUE SPECIES
scenes.narration: That split forms Dodrio, a unique species.
scenes.caption: THE SPLIT CREATES DODRIO

scenes.headline: THREE BRAINS, COMPLEX PLANS
scenes.narration: Dodrio's three brains help it execute complex plans.
scenes.caption: THREE BRAINS

scenes.headline: TOO MUCH THINKING
scenes.narration: But it may think too much and become immobilized.
scenes.caption: THINKING TOO MUCH HAS A RISK

scenes.headline: ADVANTAGE OR RISK?
scenes.narration: Are three brains an advantage, or too much thinking?
scenes.caption: ADVANTAGE OR RISK?
